purpose: F034 combined update: append 48 gunfire/vehicle-focused training scenes; mirror raw stereo features with x-reflected targets; random five-second windows on a 100ms grid. 400 sampled epochs, 12 windows per each of 96 scenes, 1152 samples/72 updates per epoch, 28800 updates total. Fixed unaugmented validation/test. This is not a single-factor augmentation ablation.
